title: ChatApiRequestContract
description: Validated JSON body contract for ChatA and ChatB. Persona is bound by the server endpoint and is not client-controlled. Direct clients use Bearer auth; browsers use an HttpOnly session plus CSRF token. Transport policy applies settings-injected caps and shared Redis limits.

document_score_threshold.description: Runtime-approved value injected by Settings; 0.85 is only a calibration candidate and is not a schema default.

cliff_delta.description: Runtime-approved value injected by Settings; 0.25 is only a calibration candidate and is not a schema default.

max_selected_reviews.description: Server-capped value; the runtime default is injected by Settings and is not fixed by this schema.

max_output_tokens.description: Optional client request. effective_max_output_tokens = min(client value, Settings server cap).

timeout_ms.description: Optional client request. effective_timeout_ms = min(client value, Settings server cap).
